name: comp-219
title: Right Indicator Select
blurb: Select with checkmark indicator on the right.
description: A select where the selected item indicator is positioned on the right side instead of the default left, using CSS class overrides on the content element.
use_when: Right-to-left layouts or when you want the indicator on the right.
avoid_when: Standard left-indicator layouts or when consistency across selects matters.
a11y: Standard select behavior; indicator position is visual only.
